name: Tinnie Chow
title: Social media strategist and content specialist
bio_short: Social media strategist with more than 15 years' experience across broadcast and digital content production. Helps brands in the region develop campaigns with real business impact. Specialist in social media, content and digital marketing.
bio: Tinnie is a social media strategist with more than 15 years' experience working across all forms of broadcast and digital content production. She helps leading brands and agencies in the region develop social marketing campaigns that deliver real business impact and content that genuinely engages audiences rather than filling a feed.  Her approach to social media is creative, strategic and results-focused. She brings a producer's eye for quality content together with a marketer's understanding of what drives engagement, conversion and brand building. Her experience spans campaign strategy, content production, influencer management, community building and social media analytics.  At ISOC, Tinnie delivers social media, digital marketing and content strategy programmes. She is particularly effective at helping organisations move beyond formulaic social media activity towards creative, purposeful campaigns that connect with their audiences. Her production background gives her a practical understanding of how to create content that performs across different platforms and formats, and she helps participants develop the creative confidence to produce distinctive, high-quality digital content. Her regional experience means she understands the social media landscape and audience dynamics of the Middle East market. Tinnie is based in Canada and trains in English.
